verdict.rationale: Grafana exposes a documented public HTTP API with a live OpenAPI spec (grafana-probe-3), supplemented by CLI (grafana-probe-5) and observability-as-code docs describing authentication and CI/CD-friendly automation (grafana-docs-26, grafana-docs-31). This directly satisfies the AI-native/programmatic-access story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer commentary specifically validating the API's completeness/usability rather than just docs/probe evidence.
